## Signature block

This matrix is approved by the owner acting as Engineering Technical Authority and SMA Technical Authority (charter section 2), as CIO/SAISO designee for the section 3.11 relief (NPR 7150.2D sections 2.2.1 and 2.2.6) and as Health and Medical Technical Authority for the health and medical implications of the tailoring (App. C.3; section 2.2.1), who also accepts as the risk taker the human safety risk of the SWE-022, SWE-023 and SWE-219 tailoring (NPR 7150.2D section 2.2.1). The signature is section 7.1 of the decision memo named above; it records the git hash of the commit whose `docs/process/rmm.json` content was approved, and the approver and date are carried in this matrix (`meta.approval`, SWE-126 b). Rows dispositioned T or NA constitute the approved tailoring (NPR 7150.2D section 2.2, SWE-121, SWE-125).
